hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-black text-gray-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-gray-900

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Flat solid surfaces. 1px solid border-gray-200, no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-sm). Max 4px or 8px border-radius.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).

components.buttons: Subtle roundness (rounded-md max). High contrast. Primary: bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-800. Accent CTA: Use functional colors like success green for 'Clock In'.
components.inputs: Flat, sharp borders. 1px solid gray-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:border-black.
components.charts: Shadcn chart components or Recharts. Minimalist design. Functional color coding. Line charts for trends, Bar charts for categories.
components.tables: Dense rows, 1px bottom border per row. Hover state on rows. Left-aligned text.
components.navigation: Sticky sidebar or top nav with 1px border. Nav bar must have a background (not completely transparent).

interactions.hover: Always explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-black hover:text-white).
interactions.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default state.
interactions.animation: Micro-interactions for feedback. Minimalist. Meaningful animations that do not interfere with functionality.

icons: Use lucide-react (already installed). Provide crisp, functional iconography.
testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role.
instructions_to_main_agent: Follow Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) for a clean, professional, and dense SaaS dashboard.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid for the dashboard (dense, strict hierarchy, max space utilization).
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Do not use card components everywhere; favor cardless layouts or flat shapes with 1px borders.
Make sure forms (clock in, manual entry) use customized Shadcn UI components.
For the Timer / Clock-in widget, place it prominently (Top-Left North Star Metric area) and use Functional Colors (Green = Clocked In / Active, Red/Black = Clocked Out).
Provide Smart Empty States with Call to Actions if no time is logged or no entries exist.
Use Shadcn charts for team stats and hours logged.
Ensure all data-testid attributes are set correctly for all buttons, links, inputs, and interactive elements.
Create a clean Layout with Sidebar Navigation for Desktop and Hamburger for Mobile.
Provide a toggle/switch for views if necessary, but keep the core interface monochrome with functional accents.
